items.text: Ali Abdollahi, Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces, emphasized Iran's control over the Persian Gulf and the prohibition of American forces entering the area. He stated that the US should not expect its military to re-enter the Persian Gulf. These remarks were made in response to the possibility of renewed American attacks.

Masoud Pezeshkian traveled briefly to Mashhad on Friday evening and visited the burial site of Ali Khamenei and his deceased family members. No prior reports about this trip were published. No further details about the trip have been released.

In Mehr 1405, 66 deaths due to lack of safety at work and 288 cases of worker injuries were recorded. Additionally, 53 gatherings and 13 worker and union strikes were reported. These statistics reflect various violations of workers' rights.

A schoolgirl said in a video to Iran International that the heavy cost of school supplies has become difficult for her father to afford. She added that the Islamic Republic causes them to lose interest in studying and stop attending school.

Saeed Hasani, a Bahá'í citizen residing in Shiraz, has been held in Adelabad prison without a clear legal status for 124 days. No court session has been held to review his case so far. Authorities have not provided clear responses to his family's inquiries.

Mohammadreza Talebi, a Basij member injured during the December 1404 protests, died after about 9 months in a coma. He was injured on January 9 in District 7 of Tehran. This news was reported by the Islamic Republic of Iran Broadcasting.

Rouhollah Rahimpour said the Islamic Republic initially tries to buy time by showing readiness for negotiation and reduce the potential costs of war. He added that if this approach fails, Tehran may resort to military confrontation. The reason is that the cost of retreat is higher than continuing confrontation.

Ahmad Alavi, an economist, stated that limiting Iran's access to land routes through Iraq and Pakistan disrupts the transfer of goods and increases the cost of supplying goods and services. This disruption can intensify inflation and reduce the value of the national currency. It also raises the economic cost of closing the Strait of Hormuz for Iran and its people.

A senior Israeli official stated that Israel and the United States are prepared for a new operation against the Islamic Republic. The final attack plan has not yet been approved. This news was announced by Israel's Channel 11.

Oil pollution on the coast of Qeshm on the first of Aban has raised concerns about damage to the marine environment and aquatic life. This pollution could cause long-term damage to the southern coasts of Iran. Compensating for these damages may take years.

Foreign ministers from several European and regional countries emphasized the need to resolve the crisis with the Islamic Republic through diplomacy at the Istanbul meeting. They warned about the consequences of escalating tensions for maritime security, supply chains, and energy markets. They also condemned the Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and the Red Sea.

Masoud Pezeshkian emphasized that the duty of officials is to implement justice and rights, stating that people are dissatisfied because they do not see justice but observe officials' conflicts. He added that fighting leads nowhere and called for officials to act more correctly and efficiently. Pezeshkian also stressed that a person's actions reveal the truth and correctness of their work.

Ehsan Arbab, a blogger, was arrested for publishing content on social media. A video of his forced confession has been released, but the conditions under which it was recorded are unclear. In the video, he expresses regret.

The PSG vs Lyon match was postponed from Sunday to Monday, October 26 at 20:30 at the request of the Paris police governor. This change coincides with the Ballon d'Or ceremony held in London. The rescheduling of matches occurred ahead of nationwide protests in France.

Farzad Tajareh reported 357 deaths due to traffic accidents in the first six months of the current year in Markazi province. Among them, 64 died in urban accidents and 293 in intercity accidents. Mehdi Mirzaei described Saveh county as critical and accident-prone.

The head of water resources in Rabat Karim and Baharestan counties announced that the land subsidence rate in parts of the Tehran-Karaj plain has reached 20 to 30 centimeters per year. About one thousand illegal wells are active in these two counties, and the groundwater aquifers have lost their water-bearing capacity. He warned that subsidence could threaten vital infrastructure in the region.

The Islamic Republic is increasing the number of surveillance cameras in the city of Astara. The stated purpose of this action is to continue suppressing citizens. This was reported by a viewer of Iran International.

Esteghlal team will fly directly to Dubai on Sunday to play against Shabab Al Ahli in the Asian Elite League. Esteghlal's use of the presidential charter plane for the international flight has been protested by Tractor club. Tractor's CEO stated the government requested $100,000 for the plane, but Esteghlal's board chairman denied this.

Canada's senior trade negotiator stated that despite informal contacts with the US, there is no clear path to resume formal trade negotiations. These remarks were made at the Toronto Global Forum. The report was prepared by Mahsa Mortazavi from Iran International.

Mokhtar Al-Boshokeh, a political prisoner in Arak prison, ended his nearly three-week hunger strike following a promise from officials to address his demands. His physical condition is poor, suffering from kidney and digestive issues. He has not yet received adequate medical treatment.

Paris is preparing for protests on Saturday, November 23, with police and army forces deployed in the streets. Shops have boarded up their windows to prevent possible unrest. The French Minister of the Interior stated that 70,000 police officers will be deployed nationwide to ensure the security of the demonstrations.
Two individuals were arrested in Kermanshah province by the IRGC on charges of espionage. A video of their forced confessions has been released. The circumstances of the recording are unclear.

Iran ranked sixth in the 2026 Nagoya Para Asian Games with 26 gold, 36 silver, and 40 bronze medals, totaling 102 medals. Previously, Iran ranked second in the 2022 Hangzhou Para Asian Games with 44 gold medals. The Minister of Sports cited the 12-day and 40-day wars and youth development in some sports as factors affecting the team's performance.
A citizen criticized the rising prices of cheese and eggs in a video sent to Iran International. He called the officials of the Islamic Republic incompetent. The video highlights livelihood issues.

People have reacted to the recent increase in internet tariffs in Iran. The prices of internet packages have risen significantly, and users complain about poor service quality and high costs. Operators have increased tariffs by up to 40%, causing dissatisfaction among users.

Kayhan newspaper considers a popular uprising simultaneous with US and Israeli attacks as likely and certain based on security reports. Ali Shirazi from Iran International pointed to Kayhan's concern about the reduced presence of government supporters in nightly gatherings. The decline in support may be due to the government's limited ability to provide economic benefits.

In the NBA, Boston Celtics defeated New York Knicks with Jason Tatum's outstanding performance. Tatum scored 36 points, 25 of which were in the second half. The game ended 107-103 in favor of the Celtics.

171 political activists and prisoners supporting the monarchy in Iran signed a statement expressing their support for Prince Reza Pahlavi. The statement was issued on the occasion of the 4th, 7th, and 9th of Aban. The signatories emphasized continuing efforts to achieve a free Iran.
Two environmental offenders who assaulted a forest ranger in Neka county were arrested. The incident occurred in one of the forest areas. The perpetrators are being prosecuted.

Recent polls show that neither of the two main factions in Israel can secure a parliamentary majority. Both Netanyahu's coalition and the opposition bloc are expected to fail. These results were released before the general elections.

The Wall Street Journal, citing informed American officials, reported that US warships in the Middle East are preparing for a possible escalation of conflicts to be ready if President Trump decides to launch a new round of attacks against Iran in the coming weeks. During a rare visit to the aircraft carrier George Washington and a guided-missile destroyer in the Arabian Sea, flight operations and extensive resupply of ammunition including long-range land-attack missiles and bunker-buster bombs were observed. The carrier's captain said, 'We are always ready.'

Alireza Beiranvand, the national football goalkeeper, will begin his military service with Fajr Sepasi Shiraz football team from the first of Aban. He cannot play for the team until mid-season due to the closed transfer window. Previous attempts to serve in the Nirou-ye Zamini team were unsuccessful.

Gholamhossein Mohseni-Eje'i described the current war with Israel as an "existential war" and said Israel wants the destruction of Iran. He also emphasized the need to control inflation without worsening recession or increasing unemployment. Mohseni-Eje'i added that solving economic problems requires considering internal and external conditions, war, and sanctions simultaneously.
In Lahijan, a man killed his ex-wife. The remains of the woman were discovered about two months after the murder, and the suspect confessed. The motive was stated as previous disputes and conflicts.
A video shows Arasto Salimian's mother holding his shirt and saying her life stopped after his death. Arasto Salimian was killed on January 8, 2026, in Chalus. He was 27 years old.

The police commander of Kashan announced the closure of four commercial units in the city. The reason for the closure was stated as non-compliance with relevant laws and regulations. This action took place in Kashan.

Thirty-four days after the start of student protests in France, a new round of widespread demonstrations is planned for Saturday, 2 Aban. These protests include students, university students, yellow vests, and labor unions. Additionally, citizens in Orléans took to the streets against the far-right party.

Maryam Abdollahi reported increased restrictions and the transfer of Rashid Mazaheri to solitary confinement after his protest against insults to Ferdowsi. Mazaheri is imprisoned in Urmia Central Prison and faced punishments due to his objection to statements about Ferdowsi and Iranian historical heroes. His wife has called for clarification of his situation in prison.

The Saudi-led military coalition announced it intercepted two missiles launched by Yemeni Houthis towards Taif and Yanbu. Saudi Civil Defense issued a warning of potential danger in several western regions including Mecca, Taif, and Yanbu, which was later lifted. Additionally, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia have completed the approval process for the Makkah joint defense pact, and Turkey is undergoing its legal procedures.

Pedram Mahmoudi, the owner of a cafe-restaurant, lost sight in both eyes on the evening of January 9, 2026, after about 26 pellets hit his face. He spoke in a video about living in darkness and the difficulties after the incident. His wife has reopened the cafe-restaurant despite the challenges.

Pouria Bagheri, a 22-year-old sports science student, was killed by suppressors on the evening of January 8, 2026, in Shahriar. His mother posted a video saying he has become immortalized in history. In the video, Pouria vowed to change his life one day.

Hossein Mohibi, spokesperson of the IRGC, said at a conference in Qazvin that the fate of the apocalyptic war is absolute victory for Iran and that Iran will become a global superpower. He emphasized that enemies seek to weaken Iranian and Islamic identity and the society's connection to religion. Mohibi stated that the current confrontation also involves cultural, identity, and civilizational aspects that must be understood.
A teacher in Dehbakri district of Bam was suspended for assaulting a student. The teacher has been referred to the disciplinary board. A judicial case has also been filed regarding the incident.

The Haft Aban Front is holding the ceremony for its fourth anniversary. The event aims to review the activities, political goals, and positions of this organization regarding Iran's future. It also reflects participants' views on recent developments in the country.

Fadahossein Maleki mentioned a new scenario of proxy ground attacks in the west and east of the country. He noted the clear involvement of two Arab countries in the unrest in the southeast. Maleki also stated that this issue was communicated to Pakistani friends.

Iranians residing in Stockholm have been holding protests and marches for nearly 10 months to raise their voices to the global community. Mehran Abbassian from Iran International reported on this issue. An interview was also conducted with participants in the Saturday, 2 Aban gathering.

In October 1405, at least 145 arrests and a total of 3016 months of imprisonment for 58 citizens were recorded. Additionally, 24 months of exile, 697 lashes, and 11 travel bans were reported. Furthermore, 13 summons to judicial authorities and 4 house searches were documented.

Gianni Infantino, FIFA president, stated that he has the support of a very large majority of the football world. He denied considering resignation over the controversy about selling part of the World Cup commercial rights and apologized for the communication process. UEFA has requested key documents of the FFE plan by November 2, but Infantino did not specify when they will be released.

The grave of Alireza Raeisi was showered with flowers. He was a 21-year-old protester detained since January 2026. Raeisi was executed on the early morning of Monday, October 4, 2026, in Dastgerd prison in Isfahan.

Steven Del Duca, mayor of Vaughan, spoke to Iran International about the resilience and solidarity of the Iranian-Canadian community in the face of great pain. He mentioned meeting Prince Reza Pahlavi and hearing the stories of families who lost loved ones. He also announced the construction of the first permanent memorial in Vaughan for the victims.

Jose Mourinho emphasized before El Clasico that recent results of Real Madrid and Barcelona do not affect tomorrow's match. He said this game is not a real test and Real Madrid will win trophies with him. Mourinho believes opinions about the teams' chances have not changed.

Gholamhossein Mohseni-Eje'i stated that the country is not prepared for wartime conditions. He emphasized that actions and support are not aligned with wartime status. He also said that institutions should not operate as they do in peacetime.

Mohammadreza Ahmadi Sangar, representative of Rasht, stated that the Strait of Hormuz is firmly held and enriched uranium and missiles have not been lost. He also mentioned that internal cohesion has strengthened. Ahmadi Sangar criticized Araghchi's positions, saying his enemy recognition is weak.

The birthday of Alireza Sadian Ghafarkhi was commemorated in Farrokhshahr, Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari province. He was killed by agents on January 8, 2026, at the age of 22. The ceremony was held at his grave.

The US updated travel advisories for several Gulf and Middle Eastern countries due to increased risk of Houthi attacks. Iraq and Lebanon were placed at level four, "do not travel," while Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Israel were placed at level three, "reconsider travel." These changes follow increased likelihood of armed Houthi attacks and targeting of US officials in the region.

Mona Dabbagh, a citizen from Sanandaj, was transferred to the Sanandaj Correction and Rehabilitation Center to serve her prison sentence. This transfer took place today. More details are available from Harana News Agency.

Amnesty International reported that Iranian authorities should face criminal investigations for crimes against humanity. The report lists seven crimes including murder, torture, imprisonment, rape, sexual violence, enforced disappearance, and harassment during the suppression of the Woman, Life, Freedom uprising. This issue is examined in the sixth part of the documentary series "Commanders of Massacre."

Mobile internet package tariffs increased by 40% from the beginning of Aban. Citizens criticized the price increase despite low quality and internet outages. This issue was discussed in an interview with Baharan Azadi.

171 activists and political prisoners issued a statement supporting Prince Reza Pahlavi. Some signatories remain imprisoned while others face pressure from the Islamic Republic. The statement may help unify opposition forces against the government.
A video shows the commemoration of Reza Shoul's birthday at his grave. Mourners released black balloons into the sky. Reza Shoul was killed on January 8, 2026, during protests in Sirjan.

Benjamin Netanyahu, at 77 years old and after nearly two decades as Israel's prime minister, is competing again to stay in power. His recent term has involved the Gaza war and direct confrontation with the Islamic Republic. Netanyahu is entering the elections with Donald Trump's support, while rivals are trying to form a government without him.

Trump has emphasized the possibility of a second epic wrath against Tehran. The Wall Street Journal reported that American ships are preparing for an attack on Iran with heavy ammunition. CNN also wrote that the US has begun evacuating its embassies in the region.

Thousands protested in Paris against rising living costs and poor educational conditions. Protesters demanded more stable jobs for teachers and better support for disabled students. The French interior minister stated that 35,000 people participated nationwide and 135 were arrested.

Hamid Mahdavi, a 38-year-old firefighter from Mashhad and an international rugby referee, was shot and killed on the evening of January 8, 2026, during protests in Mashhad. He was hit while helping the injured. This incident symbolizes the contradiction between the government's responsibilities and violence against the people.

Alireza Panahian stated that some still believe issues should be resolved through diplomacy, but the US government is not peaceful. He added that this war is existential and politicians should avoid divisive rhetoric. Panahian emphasized that this issue could break social unity.

A citizen sent a voice message to Iran International reporting the continued identification of December 2025 protesters by security agencies. He also called on Donald Trump and Benjamin Netanyahu to end the life of the Islamic Republic.

The director of nomadic education in Khuzestan announced that 170 tent schools and about 160 container classrooms are active for nomadic students. He emphasized the necessity of building 120 new schools to improve the situation. He also warned that the lack of lightning rods in some classrooms increases the risk of lightning strikes.

Yahya Sari, the military spokesman for the Houthis, announced that the group targeted several airports, an airbase, and oil facilities in Saudi Arabia in seven missile and drone operations. King Khalid Airport in Riyadh was attacked in two stages. The attacks will continue until the attacks stop and the siege is lifted.

Arsenal defeated Everton 2-0 in the eighth week of the Premier League with goals from Azri Konsa and Gabriel. This victory brought Arsenal to 21 points, equal with Manchester City at the top of the table. Manchester City lost to Aston Villa earlier the same day.

Oston Urunov, the Uzbek player of Persepolis, missed the week 10 league match against Foolad due to a hamstring injury. He was injured in the first half of the game against Mes Shahr-e Babak and was substituted. The Persepolis coaching staff stated that Urunov did not receive medical clearance to participate in the match.

Shayan Samiei Kashan referred to the Wall Street Journal report about the strengthening of equipment and ammunition of American ships in the Middle East. He said these movements indicate operational support for Donald Trump's military warnings. This military arrangement can also be used to pressure the Islamic Republic or to prepare for a possible attack.

The office of Mojtaba Khamenei announced that he met with Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei, the head of the judiciary. The time and place of this meeting were not disclosed. Previously, meetings with other Iranian officials had also been reported.

A tailor stated in a video to Iran International that she spent nearly five million tomans on needles, bobbins, thread pickers, and sewing machine stands. She criticized the country's economic situation. This highlights the rising costs of sewing equipment.

Iranian official media reported a meeting between Gholamhossein Mohseni-Eje'i and Mojtaba Khamenei. The meeting emphasized increasing social capital through justice expansion and fighting corruption. It also stressed addressing officials' negligence and combating violations.

Saudi Civil Defense announced that remnants of two ballistic missiles fired by the Houthis fell in several locations in Mecca and Medina after being intercepted. The missiles were launched towards Mecca and Medina. Parts of the missiles fell in various areas including Wadi Al-Maghamis and Jeddah.

The Stability Front has called for the Islamic Republic to withdraw from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) and to stop cooperation beyond safeguard commitments. The group also demands a reorganization of the country's defense and military doctrine as soon as possible. They have communicated this request to the members of parliament and the Supreme National Security Council.
There is a possibility of a renewed attack by the US and Israel on Iran. This topic was mentioned in a news report by Iran International. No further details have been provided.

A defendant in Tehran was sentenced to death. The death sentence of a woman in Tehran was overturned by the Supreme Court and her case will be re-examined. A man in Fars province was spared execution after the victim's family pardoned him.

Manshe Amir stated that if another war begins against the Islamic Republic, Israel will target the command centers of the IRGC and suppression forces. This action aims to increase the possibility of people's presence in the streets and the overthrow of the Islamic Republic. The focus will also be on Basij and law enforcement forces.

Homayoun Falakshahi stated that the recent rise in oil prices is mainly due to concerns about renewed military conflicts between the Islamic Republic and the United States. He emphasized that the main energy market crisis is diesel shortage, and crude oil might face oversupply. The oil price increase imposes economic and political pressure on the Trump administration and influences Washington's calculations for possible military action.

The audio version of Titraaval with Niusha Sarami was released. The report mentions the possibility of resuming attacks. Additionally, a US warship has been armed and Israeli fighter jets have been seen in the skies over Iraq.

Pedram Mahmoudi stated that on the evening of January 8, 2026, while at his workplace and not participating in protests, about 20 pellets hit his face causing him to lose sight in both eyes. He described the difficulties of living with blindness and the financial pressures on his family. He also mentioned that the hotel owner pressured to cancel the cafe contract, but his wife managed to continue the business.

The Israeli Prime Minister said the Islamic Republic has hidden its nuclear program and intends to destroy Israel. He urged people to vote for the Likud party to counter the nuclear threat from the Islamic Republic. Netanyahu warned that Israel's enemies want to defeat him.

Mehdi Mahdavi-Azad considered the destruction of Ali Khamenei's will to be unbelievable. He suggested that the will might have been hidden or destroyed due to Khamenei's opposition to Mojtaba Khamenei's succession. This issue raises questions about decision-making in the Islamic Republic.

The verbal suspension of operational workers at Tehran Municipality Waste Management Organization has resulted in the dismissal of 350 workers. Additionally, 123 workers in the restaurant and kitchen section of Jam Petrochemical have been unemployed for six months and are still seeking to return to work. This situation has raised concerns about unemployment and working conditions.

Majid Akhlaqi, secretary of the Airline Association, announced about a 40% increase in airplane ticket prices. He cited foreign exchange costs and the halt of exchange currency allocation as reasons for the increase. If exchange currency allocation resumes, ticket prices may be adjusted in Azar month.

The Spanish prosecution identified the Islamic Republic as behind the assassination attempt on Alejo Vidal-Quadras. Sentences of up to 27 years in prison have been requested for seven defendants. The attack in Madrid is linked to Vidal-Quadras's opposition activities against the Iranian government.

The USS George Washington carrier group in the region has received a large shipment of long-range missiles and bunker-buster bombs. This shipment is prepared for attacks on ground and fortified targets. Warnings have also been issued about deadly attacks planned by the Islamic Republic against American officials and citizens.

The Wall Street Journal reported that the aircraft carrier USS George Washington is preparing in the Arabian Sea for a possible attack on Iran. It has received long-range missiles and bunker-buster bombs.

The Embassy of the Islamic Republic in India announced that Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf will not attend the BRICS parliamentary leaders' meeting due to unforeseen circumstances. The Iranian parliamentary delegation will be present at the meeting. The meeting will be held on the 4th and 5th of Aban in Delhi.

A group of Iranians living in Stockholm held a march on Saturday, 2 Aban, in the Swedish capital to commemorate the immortal figures of the national revolution. This gathering is part of nearly 10 months of efforts by Iranians in Stockholm to bring the voice of Iranian protests to the global community.

Masoud Alfak said the Houthis denied attacking the holy sites of Mecca and Medina but seek to restrict regional flights. He added that continued attacks on Saudi infrastructure and international shipping might prompt the US to intervene militarily.

Ebrahim Azizi, head of the National Security Commission of the Parliament, published a map of Israel's strategic infrastructures and warned that any action against Iran's national security would lead to the depopulation of Israeli territories in less than an hour. He previously stated that any attack on Iran has a cost, and the US and Israel are well aware of this.

The Komala Party of Iranian Kurdistan Workers announced that the IRGC attacked their headquarters in Alana Valley near Erbil with a suicide drone. The attack caused financial damage but no casualties. Reuters also reported a drone attack on a camp of a Kurdish group opposing the Islamic Republic in northeast Erbil.

Kim Jong Un, the leader of North Korea, crossed the newly opened bridge between China and North Korea on November 23 and visited the border city of Dandong in China. He also visited an automobile factory and waved to the crowd on the bridge upon his return. The bridge can facilitate the transfer of heavy equipment, raw materials, and energy products needed by North Korea.

A driver sent a video to Iran International showing a kilometer-long queue for diesel on the Saveh highway towards Tehran. The video was sent to Iran International. It shows the situation of the diesel queue on this route.

An audio version of the suspicious government narrative about Mojtaba Khamenei and his father's will has been released. This narrative refers to a controversial topic. More details are provided in this audio version.

Political analyst Iman Aghayari, pointing to the strengthening of US military equipment in the region, said it seems the likelihood of large-scale military action against the Islamic Republic is greater than an agreement. He added that Washington might refrain from an attack if the Islamic Republic backs down at the last moment.

The Khatoun Bam football team left Tehran tonight for Guangzhou, China. After a 5-hour stop, the team will go to Yangon, Myanmar. Khatoun Bam will play against teams from Japan, North Korea, and Myanmar in the AFC Champions League.

On Saturday, 24 October, livelihood protests took place in Paris, Marseille, and Lyon. French officials reported 110,000 participants in Paris, while the General Confederation of Labor claimed 250,000. At the end of the march, riot police used tear gas and some protesters damaged property.

FIFA responded to Esteghlal club's inquiry by stating that the club is allowed to re-sign players who were registered in the previous season. These players are not considered new even if their contracts have ended or been terminated. Persepolis and some other clubs have considered the Albanian star's participation for Esteghlal illegal.

Tasnim News Agency reported that the Islamic Republic has not made any new proposals to Pakistani mediators. The Al Arabiya report about reopening the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for lifting the US naval blockade was denied. The Islamic Republic remains committed to its seven conditions, and insecurity in the Strait of Hormuz will continue until these conditions are met.

The newspaper Asharq Al-Awsat reported, citing Iraqi sources, that Iraqi officials suspect Israel's role in possible attacks on two arms depots of groups supported by the Islamic Republic. These depots stored Chinese-made shoulder-fired air defense systems. Investigations into these incidents and Israel's possible role are ongoing.

Bayern Munich managers are dissatisfied with Lenart Karl's performance and his presence on social media. They have asked the 18-year-old player to show less of his flashy lifestyle and focus more on football. Uli Hoeneß, the honorary president of the club, has also publicly criticized Karl.

Morad Veisi stated that the repression structure in Iranian provinces is not limited to one or two organizations. He added that many individuals, from the Friday prayer leader to the governor and commanders of the IRGC and Basij, are involved in this crime.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, said that decisions about executions are not made solely by the Revolutionary Court or the commander of the IRGC. He emphasized that the decision is made by the Islamic Republic system, not by a specific judge or commander. The Revolutionary Court is under the judiciary, and provincial IRGC units are under the national IRGC command.

The Yemeni Ministry of Interior announced that the Houthis targeted two coast guard headquarters in Aden with three ballistic missiles. The Houthi military spokesperson claimed responsibility for the attack. Severe explosions were reported in the Lahj and Aden provinces.

Arab parties in Israel may play an important role in determining the future government. Benjamin Netanyahu and his main rivals have so far rejected coalitions with these parties. If no political bloc gains a majority, the role of Arab representatives in forming the next government will be significant.

Kambiz Tavana from Iran International said Donald Trump is considering two options: military attack or reaching an agreement with the Islamic Republic, but no final decision has been made. The aircraft carrier George Washington is deployed in the Arabian Sea with advanced weapons. Unconfirmed reports of attacks on tankers and mine-laying in the region have been published.

Videos show a large fire in the pastures and greenhouse of Rudhen municipality on the evening of Saturday, 2nd of Aban. The images indicate a high intensity of the fire. The cause and exact extent of the damage are still unknown.

Barack Obama accused Donald Trump of starting an unnecessary war with Iran at a campaign rally. He said the war has not achieved its goals and has strengthened the strategic position of the Islamic Republic. Obama also attributed the rise in oil and other commodity prices to this war.
